name: Mike Murchison
office: Water Replenishment District of Southern California, Member, Board of Directors, Division 3

items.text: Mike Murchison is a water preservation advocate and consultant. His campaign says he would protect groundwater basins, invest in replenishment, and pursue a reliable, affordable water supply. He also says he would bring fiscal responsibility and transparent oversight of public funds to the board. In 2022, he ran Murchison Consulting and lobbied Long Beach officials on behalf of companies.
